name: Fully loaded annual cost per technical employee
basis: assumption: typical US fintech salary plus ~30% benefits and overhead; replace with FinTechCo HR's figure

name: Hours saved per active user per week
basis: assumption, not a measured value: base 4h = 10% of a 40h week, set below the 26% more completed tasks in field experiments at Microsoft, Accenture and a Fortune 100 company [CLM-623] and ~21% less time on task at Google [CLM-652]. The evidence also includes a trial where experienced developers were slower [CLM-650] [CLM-651], which no positive case models; if the pilot measures less than 1-2 hours, the week-9 gate returns stop. The pilot replaces this with FinTechCo's measured value.

name: Active users at steady state (share of staff)
basis: assumption: share of licensed staff active in a given month after rollout; measured by Claude Code analytics [CLM-657], or by OpenTelemetry on Bedrock or Google Cloud, which the analytics dashboard does not cover [CLM-658]

name: Realization factor (share of saved time that becomes delivered work)
basis: assumption: not every saved hour turns into output; DORA finds returns depend on surrounding practices [CLM-654]

name: Claude Code usage cost per active user per month
basis: Anthropic's published enterprise average of $150-250 per developer per month [CLM-619]; actual FinTechCo pricing to be quoted

name: Enablement hours per person (one-time)
basis: assumption: workshop plus practice time, valued at loaded cost

name: Platform and governance team (ongoing)
basis: assumption: center-of-excellence time for policy, MCP approvals, monitoring and enablement (rollout/rollout-plan.md)

name: Months to reach steady-state adoption
basis: assumption: matches the ~4-month rollout in rollout/rollout-plan.md; adoption ramps linearly to steady state
